🧩chore(workflow): centralize guidance and configure PR ownership (#10)

## Summary

- Read shared guidance from qortoo-harness, falling back to GitHub when
the local checkout is unavailable.
- Request reviews from the admin team through CODEOWNERS and assign
non-bot PR authors.

The harness generator and policy changes are in
https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-harness/pull/3; merge that PR first.

## Validation

- Harness policy synchronization check (five repositories)
- Harness unit tests (43 passed)
- `actionlint .github/workflows/assign-author.yml`
- `git diff --check`

🧩chore(workflow): centralize guidance and configure PR ownership (#10)

## Summary

- Read shared guidance from qortoo-harness, falling back to GitHub when
the local checkout is unavailable.
- Request reviews from the admin team through CODEOWNERS and assign
non-bot PR authors.

The harness generator and policy changes are in
https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-harness/pull/3; merge that PR first.

## Validation

- Harness policy synchronization check (five repositories)
- Harness unit tests (43 passed)
- `actionlint .github/workflows/assign-author.yml`
- `git diff --check`
